description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective 09.11.2015 to 15.11.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the determination of new currency exchange rates for customs duties and charges by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and rescinds a previous notification, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning the administration of customs laws and financial regulations.
